video.title: Microsoft Work IQ + Github Copilot in 1 Min!

transcript.text: Everyone is building AI agents today,
but most AI agents have one big problem.
They don't understand your business.
Think about where work actually happens,
in emails, teams, meeting notes,
documents, GitHub, and your AI model
can't see any of that. So, it just
guesses. Microsoft's Work IQ is designed
to expose your organization's knowledge
through an MCP server. I connected
GitHub Copilot to Microsoft's Work IQ
MCP server, and in this demo, I have
hundreds of fake emails, chats, meeting
notes, and documents for a fictional
company named Java. Let me ask, "What's
the latest update on Java?" Instead of
searching one database, it reasons
across everything: emails, chats,
meetings, documents, and then give me
one clear, complete answer. And that's
the difference. Work IQ isn't another
database, it's a context layer for AI
agents. So, instead of wiring up
hundreds of APIs, your agent gets access
to small set of tools and the
information it needs. Remember, context
is what turns an AI into a teammate.
Subscribe.
